ns2:section.sectionText: If you get a 'course full' error message and want to be added to a wait list for this class, go to www.fshn.illinois.edu and click on Undergraduate then Course Wait List. Wait lists will not open until one week before classes start in August. Until that time, it is up to you to continue to check the status of this course to see if a seat has become available for you.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Food Science & Human Nutrition major(s) or minor(s). Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
